description: "Snarleyyow, or, the Dog Fiend" by Frederick Marryat is a novel written during the early 19th century that melds adventure with elements of historical fiction. The story is set in the year 1699 on board the cutter "Yungfrau", focusing on Lieutenant Cornelius Vanslyperken, an avaricious and cowardly officer, and his unappealing dog, Snarleyyow.
